imd._note: IMD's latest extended-range outlook, refreshed by the Nykas Daily Refresh when IMD issues a new one (usually Thursdays). categories: above / near / below for an IMD sub-division only when IMD states it; otherwise left out.
imd.title: IMD extended range forecast (weekly press release)
imd.summary: Light to moderate scattered rain likely over parts of South Peninsular India on some days of 8–14 October, with isolated heavy rain at isolated places over Coastal Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu for a few days.

weeks.label: Week 2
weeks.text: Light/moderate scattered rainfall likely over some parts of South Peninsular India during some days of the week; isolated heavy rainfall likely at isolated places over Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, South Interior Karnataka and Kerala for a few days.

regional_text.Rayalaseema: Not named separately; IMD expects light to moderate scattered rain over parts of South Peninsular India on some days.
regional_text.Tamil Nadu: Isolated heavy rain likely at isolated places for a few days of the week.

season.text: October–December (north-east monsoon) rainfall over South Peninsular India is most likely normal (88–112% of the long-period average). October rainfall is likely below normal for India as a whole, but normal to above normal over southern parts of the peninsula. Strong El Niño conditions are expected to strengthen to the end of the year; the Indian Ocean Dipole is neutral.
